name: Job Search
tagline: Closed-source job board aggregator: 5 keyless APIs, ~30k listings per pull, medallion pipeline
description: A scheduled pipeline that pulls remote jobs from five free job-board APIs (Remotive, Jobicy, Himalayas, Arbeitnow, Greenhouse), normalizes them into one 23-column schema with a composite key, classifies every row as tech or not with recorded evidence, and tags remote-work scope (global / multi-region / region-only). Listings load into SQLite via idempotent upsert, PySpark transforms the data into clean marts, and a daily 06:00 run produces a shortlist of apply-able roles for APAC-eligible candidates.
sourceNote: Closed source. In-depth write-up with diagrams on Medium; architecture and code available on request.

name: Cyclistic Bike-share Capstone
tagline: Google Data Analytics capstone: how casual riders and members use the bikes
description: Analyzed a year of Cyclistic bike-share data to understand how casual riders and annual members use the bikes differently. Cleaned the data in Excel and Power Query, then built the analysis and visualizations in Power BI to recommend how marketing could convert casual riders into members.
sourceNote: Part of the Google Data Analytics Certificate. Full write-up with charts on Medium.
